# Sales Dashboard Overview

A compact dashboard should show how sales are trending, how channels compare, and whether ad spend is keeping pace with revenue growth. The dataset is enough to build a clear monthly performance view plus one efficiency lens.

## Recommended 3-Chart Dashboard

| Chart | Best Chart Type | What It Should Show | Key Insight to Highlight |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly Sales Trend | Line chart | Online Sales and In-Store Sales across Jan–May | Both channels are rising, with Online growing faster overall |
| Channel Mix Comparison | Grouped bar chart | Online vs In-Store sales by month | Online leads every month and the gap widens in later months |
| Ad Spend vs Sales Efficiency | Combo chart or scatter plot | Ad Spend alongside total sales trend | Spend is increasing, but sales growth appears stronger than spend growth |

## Chart-by-Chart Insight Plan

### 1) Monthly Sales Trend
- Show two lines: **Online Sales** and **In-Store Sales**
- Emphasize the steady upward trend from Jan to May
- Call out that Online Sales rise from **12,000 to 16,200** and In-Store Sales rise from **9,000 to 10,100**
- Best takeaway: sales are growing consistently, with Online contributing more momentum

### 2) Channel Mix Comparison
- Use grouped bars for each month to compare channels directly
- Highlight that Online Sales stay ahead every month
- Show the widening gap in Apr and May as Online growth outpaces In-Store growth
- Best takeaway: the business is becoming more digitally weighted over time

### 3) Ad Spend vs Sales Efficiency
- Plot Ad Spend against total sales, or use a combo chart with sales bars and ad spend line
- Highlight whether higher spend is translating into proportional revenue gains
- Best takeaway: ad spend increases from **1,800 to 2,500**, while total sales rise from **21,000 to 26,300**, suggesting improving efficiency if the trend continues

## Best Next-Quarter Metric to Track

**Metric:** **Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)**

**Why it matters:**
- It directly measures how much revenue is generated for each unit of ad spend
- Your dataset already shows ad spend rising, so ROAS will help confirm whether that investment is efficient
- It is more actionable than spend alone because it ties marketing cost to sales outcome

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Build Dashboard] https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+chart+templates+sales+metrics
Action: [Button: Learn ROAS] https://www.google.com/search?q=return+on+ad+spend+definition

## Sources

- Chart design guidance: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/charts
- ROAS overview: https://www.shopify.com/blog/return-on-ad-spend-roas
